data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Real-Time Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard with Chart.js graphs displaying live metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard updates in real-time with new data.
LLM cost over time is shown with a line chart.
Stage completion rates are displayed with a bar chart.

features.title: Chart.js Visualization Integration
features.description: Integrate Chart.js to visualize pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are displayed using a Chart.js line chart.
Cost tracking is visualized with a Chart.js bar chart.
Success rates are shown using a Chart.js area chart.

features.title: Incorporate Real Metrics from Recent Runs
features.description: Showcase real metrics from recent Artemis runs within the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics are accurate and up-to-date.
Data is presented in a clear and understandable format.
Charts reflect actual performance data.

features.title: Standalone HTML File Creation
features.description: Develop a single standalone HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file is self-contained with no external dependencies.
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file.
Chart.js library is included and functional.

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Implement auto-advance functionality and navigation controls for the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration.
Users can manually navigate between slides.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: Code Quality Metrics Display
features.description: Display code quality metrics such as TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart accurately displays code quality metrics.
Metrics include TDD compliance and adherence to SOLID principles.
Chart is visually integrated into the presentation.

features.title: Supervisor Integration Visualization
features.description: Visualize supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Pie chart accurately represents supervisor integration data.
Chart is interactive and updates with new data.
Visual style matches the overall presentation design.

features.title: Professional Presentation Design
features.description: Design a professional presentation with gradient backgrounds and smooth transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Presentation includes a gradient background.
Transitions between slides are smooth and visually appealing.
Overall design is consistent and professional.
